# Nürnberg Renegades e.V.

> Nürnberg Renegades e.V. is a flag football club in Nürnberg (Nuremberg), Germany, founded on 6 September 2022 as the first dedicated flag football club in the Nürnberg–Fürth–Erlangen region. It fields two teams: the 1st team competes in the DFFL1 (Germany's top division) and the 2nd team plays in the Bayernliga. No sign-up or contact is required to try it out — newcomers can just drop in to any training session.

This file helps AI agents and language models understand the site structure and locate the club's official pages.

The site is published in two languages: German at the root (`/training`) and English under an `/en` prefix (`/en/training`). The pages below link to the German originals; prefix any path with `/en` for the English version.

## Club facts

- Legal name: Nürnberg Renegades e.V. (registered non-profit association, "eingetragener Verein")
- Founded: 6 September 2022
- Sport: flag football — the non-contact variant of American football, where a flag is pulled from the ball carrier's belt instead of tackling
- Teams: 1st team in the DFFL1 (highest German division); 2nd team in the Bayernliga (Bavarian regional league)
- Registered address: Bartholomäusstr. 26c, 90489 Nürnberg, Germany
- Contact: info@nuernberg-renegades.de
- Membership fee: 18 EUR per month for an active playing membership; other membership types may differ
- Languages served: German (default), English

## Training

- Main season (April–October): Tuesday and Thursday, 19:00–21:00, at Sportanlage DJK BFC, Hofer Str. 30, 90411 Nürnberg
- Off-season (November–March): Tuesday 20:00–22:00 indoors at Adalbert-Stifter-Schule, Julius-Leber-Straße 108, 90473 Nürnberg; Thursday 19:00–21:00 at Sportanlage DJK BFC
- Trying it out: no registration, no prior contact and no experience required. Turn up in sportswear and football boots; the first sessions are free. Flags and other equipment are provided once you train regularly.
- All skill levels and beginners are welcome.
